prompt: Your skill suffix (the same one as write-like-<suffix>)
help: The daily reads its voice from write-like-<suffix>.

prompt: Your name as the skill should call you
Your full name as the standup bot prints it
help: Used to recognise your own update among everyone else's.

prompt: Subject pronoun the skill uses for you
help: she / he / they

prompt: Object pronoun
help: her / him / them

prompt: Possessive pronoun
help: her / his / their

prompt: Phrases that should trigger the skill
help: Comma-separated, quoted. Add phrases in every language you use.

prompt: What posts the standup
help: The bot or app whose questions the note answers, e.g. the name of your standup bot.

prompt: Slack channel the standup lands in
help: With the #, e.g. #team-daily.

prompt: Slack id of that channel
help: e.g. C0123ABCD (channel details -> bottom of the About tab).

prompt: How your update is recognised in the channel
help: Bot-posted updates often carry the author only in the body. Give the exact text that marks your post.

prompt: Your Slack member id
help: e.g. U0123ABCD. Used to search your own messages inside the window.

prompt: The standup's 'what did you do' question
default: What have you done since yesterday?

prompt: The standup's 'what next' question
default: What do you plan to do next?

prompt: Standup questions you answer yourself (optional)
help: e.g. "How do you feel today?". The note leaves them out.

prompt: Language of the note
Who reads the channel
help: One sentence; it sets how technical a sentence may be.
default: People outside engineering read this channel, so every sentence has to land for a reader who is not on your project and may not be technical.

prompt: Example hook line for the lead (optional)
help: e.g. "Billing - the invoice export is in :muscle:". Usually starts with the main project's name.

prompt: Emoji for the daily, as workspace codes (optional)
help: Space-separated codes. Leave empty for a note without emoji.

prompt: Your Notion user id (optional)
help: Lets the skill find Notion pages you created inside the window. Leave empty to skip Notion.

prompt: Board reconciliation to dispatch (optional)
help: A subagent or skill that reconciles ticket status against merged/open PRs inside the window, e.g. "the `flow-pm` skill in close mode". Leave empty to use gh only.

prompt: Where a scheduled run writes its output (optional)
help: If the note is also generated on a schedule, the file it lands in, e.g. ~/.claude/briefings/daily-<today>.md. Leave empty if not scheduled.

prompt: When a scheduled run drafts the note (optional)
help: e.g. 14:00 on weekdays. Leave empty if not scheduled.

prompt: Name of the scheduler job (optional)
help: The launchd label, cron entry or routine name, so a run can be traced back to it.

prompt: When you usually post the note (optional)
help: e.g. between 16:00 and 23:30. It tells the skill how stale a scheduled draft may be.

prompt: Tool that copies the archived draft to the clipboard (optional)
help: A script or button that reads drafts/<today>.md. Leave empty if none.

prompt: Language for short chat messages to you
